description: This file defines codecs, serializers, and copiers for the ImmutableList<T> type within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes a class for serializing/deserializing ImmutableList<T>, a surrogate type for serialization, and a copier for deep copying ImmutableList<T> instances.

classes.name: ImmutableListCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableList<T> that converts to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: ImmutableListSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type used for serializing ImmutableList<T>, contains a List<T> of values.

classes.name: ImmutableListCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableList<T> that handles recursive copying of elements.

methods.name: ImmutableListCodec<T>.ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableListSurrogate<T> back into an ImmutableList<T>.

methods.name: ImmutableListCodec<T>.ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableList<T> into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: ImmutableListCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an ImmutableList<T>, handling cyclic references and optional copying of elements.
